lines.q: Which is bigger, Saturn or Jupiter?
lines.a: Jupiter! About one hundred forty thousand kilometres wide, the king of the planets.

lines.q: Jupiter's moon Ganymede, or the planet Mercury?
lines.a: Ganymede! A moon bigger than a planet, by almost four hundred kilometres.
Earth! But only by about six hundred kilometres. Venus is almost our twin.

lines.q: Last one. Our Moon or Pluto?
lines.a: Our Moon! Pluto is only about two thirds as wide. Think you can get all four? Go again!
